start.welcome: Hi {name}! I'm Pot Bot. I track your FPL league's weekly pot, check Telebirr payments and post the results. I never hold or send money. Send /help to see how it works.
web.placeholder: Pot Bot Mini App is coming soon.
help.text:
How Pot Bot works
Each gameweek, everyone pays the entry fee to the coordinator on Telebirr. The highest score after transfer hits wins the pot, and the runner-up skips the next fee. Pot Bot keeps track and checks payments, but it never holds or sends money.

What to do
1. Tap Claim my team in the group, press Start and pick your team. Do this once.
2. Before the deadline, send the fee to the coordinator on Telebirr.
3. Send your Telebirr screenshot to me in private, or post it in the group and mention {bot}.

If you don't pay by the deadline, you can't win that gameweek, and you owe nothing for it. If I can't confirm a screenshot, the coordinator checks it.

Commands
/status: who has paid, the pot and the time left
/table: this gameweek's scores and the overall table
/help: this message

For the owner and coordinator
/setup <league link>: link this group to an FPL league
/settelebirr <name>: the name payments must go to
/coordinator: reply to someone to make them coordinator
/markpaid <team ID>: record cash or another payment
/markunpaid <team ID>: undo a payment
/override: correct a score or name a winner
/rules: show the league's rules
/setrule <name> <value>: change a rule
/link <team ID>: reply to someone to link them to a team
/unlink <team ID>: remove a link
common.fplDown: I can't reach FPL right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
common.ownerOnly: Only the league owner can do that.
common.noLeague: This group isn't linked to an FPL league yet. Run /setup first.
setup.groupOnly: Run /setup in your league's group chat, not here.
setup.adminOnly: Only a group admin can run /setup.
setup.usage:
Paste your FPL league ID or standings link, like this:
/setup https://fantasy.premierleague.com/leagues/123456/standings/c

You'll find it on the FPL site: open your league's standings and copy the address.
setup.inviteLink: That's an invite link, which I can't read. Open your league's standings on the FPL site and send me that address instead, or just the number in it: /leagues/123456/standings/c
setup.notFound: I couldn't find FPL classic league {id}. Check the ID and try again.
setup.alreadyLinked: This group is already linked to {name}.
setup.cancelled: Setup cancelled. Run /setup again whenever you're ready.
setup.badGw: The first gameweek must be between GW{first} and GW{next}. Leave it out to start at GW{next}.
setup.noNextGw: There are no gameweeks left to play this season.
setup.working: Loading the season. This can take a moment.
setup.done: {name} is linked. First pot gameweek: GW{gw}.
setup.seasonEmpty: No gameweeks have been played in the bot yet.
setup.seedFreePass: Free pass for GW{gw}: {names} (runner-up in GW{previous}).
setup.joinPrompt: Everyone: tap the button, press Start, and pick your team. I can only message you privately after that.
join.invalid: That link isn't valid any more. Ask your league owner for a new one.
join.none: Every team in {league} has been claimed. If yours is wrong, ask the league owner.
join.notInGroup: Only people in the league's group can claim a team. Join the group first, then tap the link again.
join.taken: Someone just claimed that team. Pick another.
join.success: You're in! You're linked to {team} in {league}.
link.usage: Reply to someone's message with /link <FPL team ID> to link them to that team.
link.notFound: No team with ID {id} in this league.
link.userHasTeam: That person is already linked to another team in this league.
unlink.usage: Use /unlink <FPL team ID> to remove the person linked to that team.
unlink.done: {team} is no longer linked to anyone.
settle.payoutNote: The coordinator sends this by Telebirr. Pot Bot never holds or moves money.
settle.carry: {amount} birr rolls into the next pot.
settle.noWinner: Nobody was eligible to win this gameweek.
settle.waitingForReview: GW{gw} can't settle yet: {count} payment(s) sent before the deadline still need your review.
override.denied: Only the league owner or coordinator can do that.
override.usage:
To correct a score:
/override score <FPL team ID> <gameweek> <points> [transfer cost]

To name the winner:
/override winner <gameweek> <team IDs> [runner <team IDs>]
Separate several team IDs with commas.
override.noGameweek: GW{gw} isn't part of this league.
override.notStarted: GW{gw} hasn't started, so it has no result to correct.
override.noTeam: No team with ID {id} in this league.
override.scoreSaved: Saved: {team} scored {points} with a {cost} point transfer cost in GW{gw}. It will be used when GW{gw} settles.
override.nextLocked: GW{gw} has already started, so its fees and free passes were not changed. Please sort those out by hand.
coordinator.usage: Reply to someone's message with /coordinator to make them the league's coordinator.
rules.invalid: That isn't a valid value for {key}. Send /rules to see the current settings.
payments.paidGroup: {name} paid for GW{gw}. The pot is now {pot} birr.
payments.paidPrivate: Got it, you're paid for GW{gw}. I've told the group.
payments.lateNextWeek: That payment is dated after the GW{late} deadline, so it doesn't count for GW{late}. It counts for GW{gw} instead.
payments.notReceipt: That doesn't look like a Telebirr payment screenshot, so I didn't count it.
payments.failed: That Telebirr transaction didn't succeed, so I didn't count it.
payments.wrongReceiver: That payment went to someone else. Payments go to {name}.
payments.short: That payment is {amount} birr, but {due} birr is due. I didn't count it. Ask the coordinator if something's wrong.
payments.duplicate: That transaction number has already been used, so I didn't count it.
payments.alreadyPaid: You're already sorted for GW{gw}. No need to send anything.
payments.notLinked: I can't match you to a team yet. Tap the league's claim link and pick your team first.
payments.whichLeague: You're in more than one league, so please post your screenshot in that league's group and mention me.
payments.noGameweek: There's no gameweek to pay for right now.
payments.sentToReview: I couldn't confirm this one automatically, so I've sent it to the coordinator. You'll hear back here.
payments.nudge: {name}, if this is your Telebirr payment, reply to the photo and mention me so I can check it.
payments.sendScreenshot: Send me your Telebirr screenshot here, or post it in the group and mention me.
review.reason.unreadable: the screenshot couldn't be read fully
review.reason.future_date: the date is in the future
review.reason.receiver_not_set: no Telebirr receiver name is set yet (/settelebirr)
review.reason.ai_unavailable: automatic reading isn't available right now
review.reason.out_of_window: the date is outside any payment window
review.memberApproved: The coordinator approved your payment for GW{gw}.
review.memberRejected: The coordinator rejected your payment for GW{gw}. Ask them if you think that's wrong.
review.coordinatorUnreachable: I can't message the coordinator privately until they press Start on this bot, so this review is here instead.
settelebirr.usage: Use /settelebirr <name>, with the receiver's name exactly as Telebirr shows it.
markpaid.usage: Use /markpaid <FPL team ID> [gameweek] for cash or other payments.
markpaid.settled: GW{gw} has settled. Use /override to change its result.
markunpaid.usage: Use /markunpaid <FPL team ID> [gameweek] to undo a payment.
markunpaid.done: {team} is no longer paid for GW{gw}.
markunpaid.notPaid: {team} has no payment to undo for GW{gw}.
reminder.group.polite: GW{gw} payment reminder: {left} until the deadline. Still to pay: {names}
reminder.group.cheeky: {left} to the GW{gw} deadline and these people still haven't paid: {names}. The pot is waiting.
reminder.group.urgent: Last call! GW{gw} closes in {left}. {names}: pay now or you can't win this week.
reminder.private.polite: Friendly reminder: your GW{gw} fee is {fee} birr, due in {left}. Send it to {receiver} on Telebirr, then send me the screenshot.
reminder.private.cheeky: Still no sign of your {fee} birr for GW{gw}. {left} left. Send it to {receiver} on Telebirr, then send me the screenshot.
reminder.private.urgent: Only {left} left to pay your {fee} birr for GW{gw}, or you can't win this week. Send it to {receiver} on Telebirr, then send me the screenshot.
deadline.nobody: Nobody has paid for this gameweek.
status.noGameweek: There's no gameweek to show yet.
status.whichLeague: You're in more than one league, so please ask in that league's group.
sync.joined: {team} ({manager}) joined the FPL league. Claim your team here: {link}
sync.rejoined: {team} ({manager}) is back in the FPL league.
sync.left: {team} ({manager}) has left the FPL league, so they won't be charged from now on. Any fee they hadn't paid is cancelled.
rules.saved: {key} is now {value}. Gameweeks that have already started aren't affected.
